That covered: a warning-only gate, an hourly verifier on main, `gpu: 2, chrome: 1`, BASELINE-GUARD re-planned, the rule and skill text updated, and accepting that an unintended image change can sit on main for about 2 hours.

Carry out, adjusted for 2.3.0:

Weigh repointing them at `python3 "$ORCHESTRATE_SCRIPT" main-check <name>` (no lock of its own) against having the verifier read the shared result. Pick the option that disturbs open branches least, and say why.
